title: Taking an item flagged theft ('a headframe lantern, unlit... Ness is watching: taking it is theft') uses the exact same menu phrasing/format as dozens of harmless, non-theft 'take' prompts elsewhere (e.g. the free plain sword at the Forge). The take succeeded instantly with no confirm step, then produced a real lasting cost: an in-the-moment companion disapproval (Tamsin) and a standing NPC grudge later ('so is my patience for you'), all riding on a tag that is easy to skim past.
where: The Head-Frame (Cinderhall) / action 'take a headframe lantern, unlit'
